title: Air-Stable, Nanostructured Electronic and Plasmonic Materials from Solution-Processable, Silver Nanocrystal Building Blocks

fullDocumentReview.label: Complete supplied main review; SI unverified
fullDocumentReview.independent_audit: The selected p.7 microwave colloidal Ag preparation and author-stated approximately 5 nm product were independently checked. The complete nine-page main article was read to delimit this selected contribution; its six postdeposition film treatments and device/property results remain outside the accepted recipe inventory. SI was not reviewed.
